description: Register this agent so locks and timers can attribute work to it. Returns an opaque id. Pass the id as holder to iyke_lock_acquire. Repeated calls with the same {id} bump last_seen_at; omit id to mint a new one.

id.description: Optional. Caller-supplied id (e.g. session-derived). Server mints one if omitted.

name: iyke_agent_register
